title: Searching and asking questions
intro: The search box in the top bar finds files by name or by what is inside them. If your company has turned on AI, you can also ask questions.

sections.heading: Search for a file
text: Click the search box, type a word or a file name, and press Enter. Depot looks through every library you can open, and finds a word even when it is only inside a file.

sections.heading: Choose what you search
steps: Click the button next to the search box. It starts with **Auto**.
Choose **Auto** to search names and contents, or answer a question.
Choose **Contents** to search file names and what is inside files.
Choose **File names** to match file names only.
Choose **Ask AI** to treat everything you type as a question.

sections.heading: What the results show
steps: Folders whose name matches come first. Under each one is the library and folder it lives in. Click it to open the folder.
Files come next, each with its folder under the name. Click one to open it.

sections.heading: Narrow the results by type
steps: Choose **Folders** to see only the folders that matched, or a kind of file such as **Documents** or **PDF**. Choose **All** to see everything again.
sections.note: The same menu works while you are browsing a folder: **Folders** shows only its subfolders, **Documents** only the Word files, and so on.

sections.heading: Sort the results
steps: Results start with the best match first.
Click **Name**, **Size** or **Modified** to sort by it. Click again to sort the other way, and a third time to go back to best match first. Depot remembers your choice for your next search.

sections.heading: Ask a question
text: Type a full question in the search box and press Enter. For example: What does the Northfield Clinic proposal cost? A window called **Ask the collection** opens.
steps: Your question appears at the top.
The answer appears underneath. It only uses files you are allowed to open.

sections.heading: Ask about particular files
steps: Select the files you want to ask about.
Click the **Ask Claude** button in the selection bar. You can also right-click a file and choose **Ask AI about this**.
Type your question, then click **Ask Claude**. The answer only uses the files you chose.
